_comment: What Render's own clients send and read to put a sandbox group in a project environment, move it to another one or take it out (w22/m603 t001). Read from the clients' source at the commits below on 2026-11-23; group_environment_contract_test.go replays every sequence against bex-api's REST routes. Paths are relative to the API base (bex serves them under /v1). $OWNER, $GROUP, $ENV_A and $ENV_B stand for the workspace, the group and two environments of that workspace. `success` is the statuses the client accepts; a step's `expect` is what the client then reads from the response. To regenerate: clone render-oss/sdk at the two tags and render-oss/cli at its tag, and re-read the files named in each client's `source`.

source: typescript/src/sandboxes/index.ts: createGroup, getGroup, setGroupEnvironment, addGroupToEnvironment, removeGroupFromEnvironment
sdk-typescript.create: createGroup({name, environmentId}) sends POST /sandbox-groups with {ownerId, name, region, environmentId}; region defaults to oregon
sdk-typescript.set: setGroupEnvironment(group, env) sends POST /environments/{env}/resources {resourceIds:[group]}, accepts any 2xx, then GET /sandbox-groups/{group}
sdk-typescript.clear: setGroupEnvironment(group, null) sends GET /sandbox-groups/{group}; when environmentId is null it returns that read; otherwise DELETE /environments/{environmentId}/resources?resourceIds={group}, accepts any 2xx, then GET /sandbox-groups/{group}
sdk-typescript.refuses: an empty environmentId, client side, before any request

sdk-python.create: create_group(name, environment_id=...) sends POST /sandbox-groups with {ownerId, name, environmentId}; region only when given
sdk-python.set: the same requests as TypeScript; the generated POST client parses a 201 body as Render's Environment, and DELETE expects 204
sdk-python.differences: region is omitted from the create body when not given (TypeScript sends oregon); otherwise none
sdk-python.refuses: an empty environment_id, client side, before any request

source: pkg/sandboxgroup/repo.go: AddToEnvironment ("relies on the API to move the group out of any environment it was in"), RemoveFromEnvironment
internal/fakes/renderapi/environments.go: 201 with the environment on add, 204 on remove, 404 "sandbox group not found" for an unknown group on both
cli.create: sandbox-groups create --name N --environment <id or name> sends POST /sandbox-groups with {ownerId, name, environmentId}
cli.set: sandbox-groups environment set <group> <id or name>: a name is resolved in the active workspace first (GET /projects?ownerId=..., GET /environments?projectId=...&name=...; an evm- id reads GET /environments/{id} and GET /projects/{projectId}), then POST /environments/{env}/resources {resourceIds:[group]}, then GET /sandbox-groups/{group}
cli.clear: sandbox-groups environment remove <group>: GET /sandbox-groups/{group}; when environmentId is null it prints that read; otherwise DELETE /environments/{environmentId}/resources?resourceIds={group}, then GET /sandbox-groups/{group}
cli.help: Moving a group into or out of a protected environment requires an admin.

unknownGroup.note: the CLI fake answers it on add and on remove; both SDKs raise a ClientError

protectedEnvironment.note: the CLI prints "you are not allowed to take this action" for any 403; both SDKs raise a ClientError
